I was incredibly impressed from the moment I stepped into the clinic. The receptionists were all polite and provided excellent service. I didn't have to wait long, my appointment was on time, and the clinic was clean and breezy with cool air conditioning.

The doctor was very lovely, had a very gentle hand, and explained every step in detail from start to finish. He provided easy-to-understand treatment recommendations. He also gave excellent advice on dental care. He was very polite and patient. He always told me what to do. If it hurt, I could tell him. But it didn't hurt at all. 👍

Most importantly, the price was reasonable, not as expensive as I thought. Plus, I can claim my Social Security benefits. The service was fast, and there was no need to wait long. If you're looking for a good dental clinic, I highly recommend this place. I was extremely impressed. 💖
